overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the posting date and time were recorded via the webpage, and the executive session topic was specific when read with the attached memorandum. Resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the September 19 meeting notice did not conspicuously record the date and time it was posted.
allegations.key_passage: This complies with the Attorney General's regulations requiring that the date and time that a meeting notice is posted be conspicuously recorded on or with the notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the meeting notice failed to list an executive session topic, the topic being listed as a land acquisition item.
allegations.key_passage: Read together, we find that the topic was sufficiently specific to indicate to the public that the Council planned to convene in executive session to discuss potential land acquisition.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
